judgment.notes: H001 supplies the characteristic and denominator/factorial conditions. N004 supplies the actual localized basis, N001 its operator matrices, and N002 the lattice-preserving matrix units and invertible binomial coefficients. All four divided-power indices in S003 lie between 0 and λ. Routine scalar-extension facts are justified in the background notes; there are no E/M applications.

S001 verifies the tensor maps and inverses, operator compatibility and inherited Lie brackets. S002 proves linear independence as well as spanning using coordinate maps. S003 identifies induced divided powers by r!X_r=x^r and r!Y_r=y^r, then transports N002's identity; E_ij(b e_k)=δ_jk b e_i identifies its extension with T_ij. Units map to units. This proves every N005 clause, including λ=0 and characteristic 2; no limiting operations occur.

All factual uses are grounded in the six direct premises, the supplied definitions, or earlier F001/F002. The witness b comes from N004 and stays local; the exported basis is existentially quantified. Isomorphism and basis properties named in local declarations are proved in S001/S002 before use. N002 supplies injectivity and preservation needed for the identification with V. No future facts, extra assumptions or private witness escape are used.

The packet alone supplies the basis existence, lattice identification, matrix formulas and matrix-unit factorization needed for this derivation. The reviewed routine tensor and residue-field facts suffice for the displayed transitions. No other R body, ancestor theorem or source-paper content is required.

The rings, tensor products, embeddings, operators and finite index set have their required definitions and guards. B is constructed in V_K from the localized basis without mapping b itself into K. A,C are restricted to 0≤r≤λ, and T is defined after the basis proof. Output coefficients mean integer images in K; all action formulas, nonvanishing claims and the complete factorization are explicitly exported.
